claims.text: The PMO release datelined 'Nuku'alofa, 22 January, 2025' states that King Tupou VI, 'today, Wednesday 22 January 2025, at the Royal Palace, Nuku'alofa', appointed Honourable Dr. 'Aisake Valu Eke 'as the Prime Minister Tonga' (as printed; the title reads 'Prime Minister of Tonga') in accordance with Clause 50A (1) of the Act of the Constitution of Tonga, and describes him as the 19th Prime Minister.
claims.uncertainty: An appointment event. The release gives no separate 'with effect from' date, no warrant signature or presentation, no time and no instrument number. The ordinal is recorded as printed and is not used to number a succession.

claims.text: The same release states that Eke was elected Prime Minister Designate at the Legislative Assembly of Tonga on 24 December 2024 and is the Member of Parliament for Tongatapu No. 5.
claims.uncertainty: Independent PMO corroboration of the Assembly selection; it is not the appointment. The release's biography (birth date, career, family) is not imported.
